verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM documents a REST API, with an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt, that covers deals, activities and calendar entries and can change real records, so an external agent could update deals through it. Gmail/Outlook emails are logged against deals automatically, which gives the agent signal data to work from. However, there is no evidence of an MCP server, of specific endpoints for updating deal stage or next step, or of any signal-driven update flow. Missing for 10: official MCP server, documented stage and next-step update endpoints, meeting-signal ingestion via API, an agent workflow that turns email and meeting signals into updates, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent update deal stages and next steps from email and meeting signals via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: REST API for Pipeline CRM (deals, people, companies, activities, calendar entries, documents
